about: Recorded on the test host from the finish-the-game evaluator as it was before WI-017 (seeded random play against the scripted defender): each sequence is a bundled scenario, its moves from the start (learner and defender alternating), an optional draw claim after them, and the outcome and message that evaluator gave. Do not edit or regenerate it; PositionGameTests replays it.
